name: Chalcedony Idocrase
original_name: カルセドニー・アイドクレーズ
source:
Star Sign: Cancer
Lapis's oldest brother.

He works as an aide to the king and is famous for always being serious on the job.
He loves his little sister, enough that he took a paid vacation to check up on her in the human world.
He greatly admires Jasper.
